notes: «وحدثني محمد» opens a second isnad (rule 3), so two groups.
The first branch ends at «هشام» with no saying written after it; the saying follows the second branch, and the reading does not carry it into the first (the names are not merged, rule 9).
«عن أبيه» is Urwa, written bare: kind relation (rule 7). Aisha is the last link.
